Mobile money named only as a tax payment means in a tender; no service status stated.

facts.fact: Mali's finance ministry project unit (PASG, AfDB-funded) invited firms to extend DGI tax e-procedures to all electronic payment means (bank, cards, mobile money) and all taxes, including a USSD application for declaration and payment.

facts.fact: Mali's finance ministry project unit (PASG, AfDB-funded) sought a consultancy firm to extend DGI tele-services to all taxes, add a USSD app and APIs, and connect all tax centres to the SIGTAS network.
